name: UGC 4286, SN 2010al field (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 4286, a spiral galaxy that hosted the Type Ibn supernova SN 2010al, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2010al-hubble
story: In this spiral galaxy, SN 2010al exploded inside a slow-moving shroud of helium-rich gas, the signature of a Type Ibn supernova. Hubble returned to the site to see what light remains.

claims.text: SN 2010al was discovered in the spiral galaxy UGC 4286
SN 2010al is a Type Ibn supernova
Its spectra show a slow-moving, helium-rich circumstellar medium
Hubble program 13029 imaged the sites of nearby supernovae
